notes: Adds the head-commit Cross-Unit-Move trailer to the unit-ownership guard: every foreign path listed with its actual owning unit and a D or M status, at least one new file in the declaring unit's namespace, each listed delete paired one-to-one with its own same-basename addition owned by the declaring unit, and each listed modification paired one-to-one with its own same-basename listed delete so no delete backs two edits. Empty or malformed manifests, unlisted foreign paths, wrong owners, added foreign path listings, deletes without their own declaring-unit counterpart, two deletes sharing one add, modifications without their own delete and two modifications sharing one delete fail closed with a named reason; the rest of the guard is unchanged. Tests cover the allowed evidence-namespace and map-owned moves, a paired modification, and each failure mode. The protected scripts/port change is authorised by the captain through oracle-change, who reviews the manifest by hand against the diff; aggregates are parent-owned.
